title: Red No. 3 Ban: FDA Revokes FD&C Red No. 3 for Food & Drugs
excerpt: The FDA revoked color additive listings for FD&C Red No. 3 under the Delaney Clause. Food deadline January 15, 2027. Drug deadline January 18, 2028. Complete timeline, state bans, and reformulation guide.
seo_title: Red No. 3 Ban: FDA Final Rule, Deadlines & Reformulation | Policy Canary
seo_description: FDA banned Red No. 3 (erythrosine) in food and drugs under the Delaney Clause. Food products must comply by Jan 15, 2027. Drugs by Jan 18, 2028. Full regulatory analysis, state bans, and industry action plan.
